title: Instrumental Action Stations
framing: The station images represent items in Rohan's personal community emergency bag. They are not generic ward stock, and family or Jay are not assigned unpaid clinical responsibility for them.
educationalBoundary: This is a decision-and-consequence exercise, not a procedure manual or a find-the-magic-object puzzle. The central PICU scene begins with incomplete evidence; selecting an image never proves it is the right action.
workedSequence: 04 then 01 — verify the current Airway Plan Card before committing the same-size spare tracheostomy tube. Improved airflow alone does not close the Code.

states.label: Available
states.meaning: Visible for consideration; relevance has not been established.

states.label: Relevant
states.meaning: The current evidence supports discussing this item.

states.label: Locked by evidence
states.meaning: Still visible, but interpretation must consider missing evidence before assignment.

states.label: Assigned
states.meaning: Responsibility is named while Rohan's communication access remains active.

states.label: Committed
states.meaning: The learner has committed this item to the branch consequence.

evidenceToConsider: External ventilator circuit load and any pull on the tracheostomy
Rohan's position and whether support changes circuit alignment
Power continuity for ventilation, suction, and communication access
evidenceGate.earlySelectionWarning: This airway option remains visible but is locked by incomplete evidence. Before assignment, consider external circuit load, Rohan's position, and power continuity. The image alone does not establish the action.

decisionPrompts: What do you notice in the image, and what remains uncertain?
What is this item intended to support in Rohan's context?
Which evidence in the central scene makes it relevant now?
Which evidence would make it irrelevant, unsafe, or premature?
What preconditions must be checked before anyone is assigned?
Who is the trained role responsible, and how will Rohan's AAC stay available while they act?
If you commit this item, what branch consequence should the team watch for rather than assuming success?
accessibilityRequirements: Every image has concise and extended alternative text.
Announcements include canonical number, item, station, state, and any warning.
All controls work by keyboard and switch access with visible focus.
Scenario time pauses while Rohan uses AAC; communication is not timed out.
Locked items remain visible and explain why they are locked.
Status is expressed with text and shape, never colour alone.
Rohan's AAC remains visible throughout the station workflow.
No response is recorded as wait or unknown, never incapacity.

centralScene.title: Central PICU scene — evidence incomplete
centralScene.description: Illustrative opening: intermittent ventilator alarm, reduced visible chest movement, increasing ectopy, Rohan's hand moving toward his neck, and an unreliable cheek switch. Pressures are climbing; right-sided air entry is reduced; ordinary suction retrieves little. Rohan reports RIGHT MIDDLE by auditory scanning. The tracheostomy is patent; the cause is not yet proven. Action stations investigate — they do not hand you a diagnosis.

indicators.label: Rohan's position
indicators.detail: Hand toward neck; positioning may load the circuit — check before assuming tube failure.

indicators.label: Ventilator and circuit
indicators.detail: Intermittent alarm with rising pressures; circuit pull, connector fit, and power continuity still unresolved.

indicators.label: Current phase
indicators.detail: Phase 03 airway / bronchoscopy decision — incomplete evidence, three imperfect pathway options ahead.

indicators.label: Communication method
indicators.detail: Auditory scanning available; cheek switch currently unreliable. Pause scenario time for AAC. No response means wait or unknown.

indicators.label: Latest alarm
indicators.detail: Ventilator pressure / ineffective ventilation pattern — not yet mapped to a single cause.

indicators.label: Unresolved evidence
indicators.detail: Distal plug versus atelectasis versus secretion burden versus inflammation; pneumothorax not diagnosed without findings.

indicators.label: Physiological reserve
indicators.detail: Severe cardiomyopathy with ICD; aggressive recruitment has previously linked to ventricular instability.

indicators.label: Crisis debt
indicators.detail: Prior emergency labour and family load sit outside unpaid clinical expectation — paid responders own the station workstreams.

assets.title: Spare Tracheostomy Tube Same Size
assets.purpose: Provides person-specific airway redundancy when current evidence and Rohan's airway plan support considering a tube change.

contextGate.warning: Do not infer tube change from the image or rising pressure alone; the tracheostomy is currently described as patent.

assets.altText: Action Station asset 1, same-size spare tracheostomy tube, Airway station, locked by evidence.

assets.title: Smaller Rescue Tracheostomy Tube
assets.purpose: Provides the smaller person-specific rescue option identified by Rohan's current airway plan.

contextGate.warning: A rescue option is not evidence that reinsertion is required; interpret the scene and current plan first.

assets.altText: Action Station asset 2, smaller rescue tracheostomy tube, Airway station, locked by evidence.

assets.title: Alternative Emergency Airway As Specified
assets.purpose: Represents the alternative airway named in Rohan's current plan without prescribing a device in the simulation.

contextGate.warning: The plan and evidence determine whether this option is relevant; the station does not teach an airway procedure.

assets.altText: Action Station asset 3, alternative emergency airway as specified, Airway station, locked by evidence.

assets.title: Airway Plan Card Current Revision
assets.purpose: Makes Rohan's current person-specific airway plan and revision status available to trained responders.

requiredEvidence: Plan interpreted with the present scene
contextGate.warning: A plan card informs judgement; it does not replace current assessment or Rohan's authorship.

assets.altText: Action Station asset 4, current airway plan card, Airway station, available.

assets.title: Tracheostomy Securing Ties
assets.purpose: Supports secure person-specific tracheostomy positioning when evidence identifies a securing need.

contextGate.warning: Availability does not establish that ties need changing.

assets.altText: Action Station asset 5, tracheostomy securing ties, Airway station, available.

assets.title: Dressings and Airway Care Supplies
assets.purpose: Supports person-specific airway site care by trained responders when the scene shows a relevant care need.

contextGate.warning: Routine care supplies are not a substitute for interpreting the pressure rise.

assets.altText: Action Station asset 6, dressings and airway care supplies, Airway station, available.

assets.title: Suction Catheters Multiple Sizes
assets.purpose: Supports assessment and secretion clearance while preserving a patent tracheostomy, within Rohan's plan.

requiredEvidence: Catheter passage and secretion yield considered
Possible distal obstruction remains in the differential
contextGate.warning: Ordinary suction has retrieved little secretion; repeated selection is not proof of a proximal blockage.

assets.altText: Action Station asset 7, suction catheters in multiple sizes, Airway station, relevant.

assets.title: Portable Suction Unit Battery Powered
assets.purpose: Provides suction continuity when wall suction is unavailable during community movement or transfer.

requiredEvidence: Suction source and battery state checked
Current location and transfer need considered
contextGate.warning: In the PICU scene, availability does not make portable suction preferable to established equipment.

assets.altText: Action Station asset 8, battery-powered portable suction unit, Airway station, available.

assets.title: Spare Ventilator Circuit
assets.purpose: Provides a known compatible circuit if evidence supports circuit failure or contamination.

contextGate.warning: Rising pressure does not by itself prove circuit failure.

assets.altText: Action Station asset 9, spare ventilator circuit, Breathing and Equipment station, relevant.

assets.title: Connectors and Adapters
assets.purpose: Maintains compatibility between Rohan's tracheostomy, circuit, and approved support equipment.

contextGate.warning: Do not add components without evidence; extra connections can change load and alignment.

assets.altText: Action Station asset 10, connectors and adapters, Breathing and Equipment station, available.

assets.title: Filters and HME Spare
assets.purpose: Provides a compatible spare filter or heat-moisture exchange component when its condition is relevant.

contextGate.warning: The station does not prescribe changing a filter or HME based on pressure alone.

assets.altText: Action Station asset 11, spare filters and HME, Breathing and Equipment station, relevant.

assets.title: Manual Resuscitator Bag Valve
assets.purpose: Provides trained responders with person-compatible backup ventilation if the supported ventilation pathway is interrupted.

requiredEvidence: Ventilation interruption or equipment failure identified
contextGate.warning: Ventilation is support, not a victory endpoint; pressure and cardiac risk remain branch consequences.

assets.altText: Action Station asset 12, manual resuscitator bag valve, Breathing and Equipment station, available.

assets.title: Oxygen Interface If Required
assets.purpose: Represents Rohan's compatible oxygen interface when current clinical evidence and his plan require it.

contextGate.warning: No oxygen setting or prescription is taught by this station.

assets.altText: Action Station asset 13, oxygen interface if required, Breathing and Equipment station, available.

assets.title: Circuit Support Straps
assets.purpose: Supports the external circuit to reduce pull and preserve Rohan's chosen and clinically appropriate position.

contextGate.warning: Support straps must respond to observed load, not immobilise Rohan or hide a circuit problem.

assets.altText: Action Station asset 14, circuit support straps, Breathing and Equipment station, relevant.

assets.title: Backup Batteries Charged
assets.purpose: Maintains power continuity for ventilation, suction, and communication equipment during transfer or interruption.

requiredEvidence: Equipment power demand and transfer duration considered
contextGate.warning: A battery image is not evidence of charge; readiness must be verified.

assets.altText: Action Station asset 15, charged backup batteries, Breathing and Equipment station, relevant.

assets.title: Power Leads and Chargers
assets.purpose: Provides labelled, compatible power connections for Rohan's support and communication equipment.

requiredEvidence: Power source and cable routing considered
contextGate.warning: Power leads must not create additional circuit pull or obstruct AAC access.

assets.altText: Action Station asset 16, power leads and chargers, Breathing and Equipment station, relevant.

assets.title: Chest Movement Indicator
assets.purpose: Adds a visible observation cue to support interpretation of breathing movement without replacing clinical assessment.

contextGate.warning: A single indicator cannot diagnose the cause of reduced right-sided air entry.

assets.altText: Action Station asset 17, chest movement indicator, Breathing and Equipment station, relevant.

assets.title: Defibrillator AED
assets.purpose: Identifies access to defibrillation equipment for trained responders if the circulation branch supports its use.

requiredEvidence: Current circulation and rhythm evidence considered
contextGate.warning: An AED is not an automatic response to every alarm or pressure rise.

assets.altText: Action Station asset 18, defibrillator AED, Circulation station, available.

assets.title: Cardiac Monitor Portable
assets.purpose: Supports observation of circulation and rhythm trends when Rohan's limited cardiac reserve is relevant.

requiredEvidence: Existing PICU monitoring and transfer context considered
contextGate.warning: Monitoring informs interpretation; it does not make an intervention inevitable.

assets.altText: Action Station asset 19, portable cardiac monitor, Circulation station, relevant. The source image may visually show 10, but the canonical number is 19.

assets.title: Monitoring Leads and Sensors
assets.purpose: Provides compatible leads and sensors for clinically relevant monitoring while preserving skin, position, and AAC access.

requiredEvidence: Skin, positioning, and communication access considered
contextGate.warning: More sensors do not equal better evidence if they obstruct communication or add unreliable signals.

assets.altText: Action Station asset 20, monitoring leads and sensors, Circulation station, available.
